evidence_status: Experimental predictions on German test cities. Not verified evidence about any road in Italy.

criteria: sett recall >= 0.70 at argmax decision on test, with Wilson 95% lower bound reported
sett precision >= 0.70 at argmax decision on test, with Wilson 95% lower bound reported
macro-F1 of primary model exceeds colour-only baseline by >= 0.10
zero image-level and cell-level leakage between train, calibration and test
predeclared_criteria.evaluated_on: official StreetSurfaceVis test cities (train=False), never used for fitting, calibration or thresholds
predeclared_criteria.interpretation: Meeting all criteria only justifies an Italian human-labelled evaluation; it never justifies product integration.
